about: Experience Syphon Filter™ 2 originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
Agency operatives Gabe Logan and Lian Xing discover that a plot to sell off the deadly Syphon Filter virus stems from within their own organization.
As they attempt to expose the conspirators and prevent the sale, the Agency responds by alerting military and police forces that Logan and Xing must be eliminated…
The two agents must strike with deadly efficiency. And with the threat of a bio-weapon disaster looming, the destiny of millions lies in their hands.
This second installment of the pulse-pounding Syphon Filter™ series was originally released in the year 2000.
This title has been converted from the PlayStation® version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features.
summary: This Second Installment of the Pulse-Pounding Syphon Filter™ Series
